_comment: SessionStart hook fragment installed by /wiki-init --dual-claude. Merges into the project's .claude/settings.json under the 'hooks' key. Loads vault/.wiki-identity-bootstrap.md as additionalContext into the main session ONLY (forked subagents don't see it). Requires CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR env var, which Claude Code sets automatically.

hooks.command: python -c "import json, pathlib, os; text=(pathlib.Path(os.environ['CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR'])/'vault/.wiki-identity-bootstrap.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'SessionStart', 'additionalContext': text}}))"
